response.text: CLOSE_DT is a true NULL. All journals balance. Next I'll look at the sign conventions, the negative invoice, the AP and GL journals, reversals, and the other quirks.

arguments.sql:
SELECT 'neg_inv' k, i."INV_ID"::text a, i."INV_AMT"::text b, i."STAT_CD" c, i."JRNL_NO"::text d, i."INV_NO" e FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_AMT"<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_vs_pay', i."INV_ID"::text, i."INV_AMT"::text, sum(p."PAY_AMT")::text, count(p."PAY_ID")::text, i."STAT_CD" FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p USING("INV_ID") GROUP BY i."INV_ID",i."INV_AMT",i."STAT_CD" HAVING (i."STAT_CD"='P' AND sum(p."PAY_AMT") IS DISTINCT FROM i."INV_AMT") OR (i."STAT_CD"='O' AND count(p."PAY_ID")>0) OR (count(p."PAY_ID")>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_inv_no', i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", count(*)::text, min(i."INV_ID")::text, max(i."INV_ID")::text FROM "APINVH" i GROUP BY i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO" HAVING count(*)>1
UNION ALL SELECT 'acct_sums', l."ACCT_CD", sum(l."DR_AMT")::text, sum(l."CR_AMT")::text, count(*)::text, '' FROM "GLJRNL" l GROUP BY l."ACCT_CD"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_jrnl_srcs', h."SRC_CD", count(*)::text, '', '', '' FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") GROUP BY h."SRC_CD"
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_before_inv', p."PAY_ID"::text, p."PAY_DT"::text, i."INV_DT"::text, '', '' FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'src_ref', h."SRC_REF", count(*)::text, h."SRC_CD", '', '' FROM "GLJRNH" h GROUP BY h."SRC_REF", h."SRC_CD"
LIMIT 150

SELECT h.*, (SELECT string_agg(l."LN_SEQ"||':'||l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT", ' | ' ORDER BY l."LN_SEQ") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") lines FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (1000,1001,2463,2474) OR h."MEMO" IS NOT NULL AND h."SRC_CD"='GL' AND h."JRNL_NO"<1100 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 30
